notes: The page at rest: the title, the search card, the code field, the submit button and the line of hints under them. `origin` is the title, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the design is the gaps between these boxes, not where the first one lands. `capture` is the card, because it is the region both clients draw identically; the raster around it is covered by the layout numbers. Widths are left out of the title deliberately: its width is the run of text, not a decision. Colours are left out deliberately too - they are what the raster proves. The states after a lookup (found, not found, rate-limited, unreachable) are separate recordings and are not part of this contract yet.

motion.notes: The search card children stagger in 100ms apart, each fading and rising 20px over 0.5s on load; a result enters from 24px below and leaves 20px upward in 0.15s. The same means the same order, travel and easing, and the app composes the same states without the network.
